verdict.rationale: An admin console for a connectivity platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as ACL suggestions or network anomaly summaries, so this axis applies. The pack has no evidence of in-product AI insights or suggestions drawn from the user's tailnet data. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Aperture is a gateway that inspects or blocks LLM requests, and the Tailscale skill lets an external coding agent work with Tailscale configuration.
